name: Cell Repair Technical Service System
summary: A technical service management system that records customers, mobile devices, dates, faults, repair details, and progress in a centralized database.
functions: Registers customers and phones, stores repair details and dates, manages progress statuses, and generates a unique public tracking code for each device.
problem: Repair companies needed a reliable record of every phone and a simple way to keep customers informed without exposing internal data or handling repeated status inquiries.
solution: I connected the desktop workflow to a centralized database and a public tracking website where customers can securely check repair progress using their unique code.
